videos.title: Someone They Knew With Tamron Hall
videos.description: Lita McClinton thinks the man at her door is just delivering a dozen pink roses, but the delivery guy delivers death instead. The decades-long hunt for justice spans multiple continents before reaching a dramatic conclusion in an Atlanta courtroom.

videos.title: Someone They Knew With Tamron Hall
videos.description: When the body of 22-year-old Misty Morse is found floating in the Indian River, police suspect one of her many boyfriends. With only a piece of nautical rope and a strip of duct tape to go on, an unusual kind of DNA could actually break the case.
